label: DR-004
note: Max-length validation is intentionally suppressed for columns that hold arbitrarily long values such as file paths, URLs, and external identifiers; reviewer must NOT flag the missing length limit or the suppression as a code smell.

known_false_positive.title: BlobKey and SourceUrl have no max length
known_false_positive.why_it_matters: Without HasMaxLength these map to unbounded text columns, so oversized values are accepted and the columns cannot be indexed efficiently. Add a max length validation to both properties.
